progress.label: B/X public demonstration gates
progress.basis: Recorded public fixtures: dungeon turns, lighting and resources, wandering contact, surprise, observed identities and encounter withdrawal. Remaining: live combat, connected AI referee and full adventure play.
progress.note: These are scoped demonstration gates, not completion of the full B/X ruleset.

roadmap.label: Full B/X RPG long-term product vision
roadmap.scope: Original 1981 B/X browser RPG: complete rules, characters, Expert wilderness, adventures, secure AI referee, replayable campaigns, optional party autonomy, presentation and full release QA.
roadmap.note: Accepted-only weighted gates; planned and partial work earn zero. Rebased from the earlier limited-delivery 36% to 19% for the full long-term scope; no completed functionality was removed.
